messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout v3.21 -> canary-eu (group=4). Change window 2026-05-05 15:00-16:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.21 PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/812
dan: Quick request: paste the backout/runbook link and who will own rollback for this canary. Also any emergency pin/hotpin syntax we should have ready?
oliver: Backout/runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-v3.21-rapid. I'll take rollback ownership for canary unless someone else wants it.
ops-bot: Ops sample commands: staged pin -> `rdeploy pin --cluster canary-eu --image redwood:v3.20 --mode staged --duration 30m --note "hold during canary spike"`. Hotpin -> `rdeploy hotpin --cluster canary-eu --image redwood:v3.21 --duration 15m --threshold p95=200ms`. If 5xx >0.7% or DB schema errors -> full rollback.
sana: Feature flag note: `ff/db/deferred_migrations=false` on canary. DB toggle command: `ffctl set ff/db/deferred_migrations false --env canary`. Also adding metric guards: p95 alert @200ms (3m), 5xx alert @0.5% (2m). Grafana watch: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/alerts/2021
dan: Oliver, can you paste a short rollback checklist (one-liners) we can copy into incident runbooks?
oliver: Rollback checklist (compact):
1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.20 --cluster canary-eu`
2) `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n redwood`
3) Evict edge caches: `opsctl cache evict --target canary-eu --pattern "prefix:*"`
4) Repair KV quick-scan: `kvtool repair --host kv-canary-eu --mode quick`
5) Check migrator logs for schema traces: `kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=db-migrator | grep -i schema`
6) Notify product and reopen change window if reattempt planned.
oncall-bot: Rollback owner assigned: oliver. Pager: +1-555-0789. Escalation path: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-platform.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/4 OK, 2/4 OK, 3/4 degraded (p95=215ms) -> auto-pause triggered by rule `p95 > 200ms`. Holding further rollouts.
dan: Auto-pause acknowledged. Oliver, recommend hotpin or full rollback? Any quick triage notes?
oliver: Seeing p95 spike on edge routing; 5xx creeping to 0.4% and a couple transient schema warnings in migrator logs. Because of schema warnings, proceeding with full rollback to v3.20. Executing step 1 now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by oliver at 2026-05-05T15:07:12Z. Will update status.
oliver: Rollback finished on canary-eu. Running post-rollback steps: restart edge-proxy, evict caches, run kv quick repair, check migrator logs.
sana: Post-rollback metrics: p95=92ms, 5xx=0.08%. Migrator logs show only cleanup traces, no active schema failures. Recommend 15m observation before any reattempt.
product-bot: Product notified. Preparing rollback blurb for release page and patching release notes.
dan: Thanks all. Please add a short postmortem to the release ticket with timeline and root-cause owners. If infra/db teams want a reattempt, schedule after RCA. Closing thread after PM note is added.
